2608.05970.title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
2608.05970.paper_summary: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.
2608.05970.paper_summary_zh: 具身視覺運動模型，包括擴散策略（Diffusion Policy, DP）和視覺-語言-行動（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型，在機器人操作基準測試中展示了令人鼓舞的表現。<lb/>然而，它們的潛力仍然受到大規模具身軌跡數據集稀缺的根本限制，導致在分佈外（OOD）場景中組合泛化能力不足，並且對捕捉可重用技能結構的能力有限。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了基於技能的記憶（Skill-Based Memory, SkillMemo）框架，該框架隱式地將長期演示分解為潛在的原子技能，並將技能級特徵集成到動態的情節記憶庫中，以解決組合任務。<lb/>具體而言，我們首先介紹了一個基於專家引導的軌跡分割模塊，該模塊建立在混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）架構之上，隱式地將軌跡劃分為由學習的門控係數表示的不同技能原語。<lb/>我們進一步設計了一個技能級情節記憶架構，該架構將緊湊的技能表示存儲為可檢索的鍵值對。<lb/>在推理過程中，記憶庫檢索出最相關的技能原語，然後與模型當前的門控分佈融合，提供強大的上下文先驗以精煉行動預測。<lb/>在模擬基準和現實世界操作任務上的廣泛實驗表明，SkillMemo 一直在增強 DP 和 VLA 的骨幹，實現了最先進的性能並超越了 $π_{0.5}$，同時對未見的任務配置展現出強大的組合泛化能力。
